about.heroSubtitle: A modern Moroccan school combining values, excellence, and openness

history.title: Our History & Journey
history.body: Madaris Nibras was born from a deep conviction: quality education is the most precious gift one can give a child. Founded in Tangier to offer a modern learning environment close to families, the school has built its path through dedicated work and the trust of families who entrusted us with their children. Over the years, we have developed an integrated educational project that meets today's needs and tomorrow's ambitions.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: Madaris Nibras is a modern Moroccan educational institution in Tangier. We support pupils from early years through secondary school through an integrated project combining academic excellence, strong values, multilingualism, integrated activities, and openness to the future. We aim to nurture confident, responsible, high-achieving pupils who are open to the world without losing their roots.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.body: To be a recognised educational space in Tangier and northern Morocco, graduating pupils capable of creativity, excellence, and responsibility in a world that demands flexibility and competence.

items.title: Faith & Identity
items.description: National and religious identity as the foundation of discipline, respect, and openness. We build the future… and preserve our roots.

items.title: Excellence & Rigor
items.description: The constant pursuit of quality in teaching, supervision, and the school environment.

items.title: Respect & Equity
items.description: Respecting every child's uniqueness and giving every learner a full chance to succeed.

items.title: Family Partnership
items.description: The family is a key partner in the educational process; we build with them, not instead of them.

meta.title: Pedagogical Project — Madaris Nibras
meta.description: Discover Madaris Nibras's educational approach, built on five essential pillars

pedagogical.heroSubtitle: A clear educational pathway from early years to secondary school

intro.title: Our Educational Philosophy
intro.body: Our pedagogical project rests on the deep conviction that true education goes beyond knowledge transmission to include character formation, skill development, and values anchoring. We don't just teach subjects — we shape human beings: thinkers, producers, and balanced individuals. That's why our pedagogical project is organized around five complementary and interconnected axes.

items.title: Values & Identity
items.detail: We believe that a grounded identity is the foundation on which all achievements are built. At Madaris Nibras, we ensure that students grow up loving their religion and country, and respecting universal human values. We weave Islamic education into the fabric of school life — not as an isolated subject, but as a spirit that animates all our activities.

items.title: Academic Excellence
items.detail: We follow national curricula aligned with the best modern educational standards. Our teachers work according to active pedagogical approaches that place the learner at the center of the educational process. We provide individualized support and continuous monitoring to ensure each student progresses at their own pace.

items.title: Multilingualism
items.detail: At Madaris Nibras, we believe languages are not merely school subjects, but tools to build the pupil's character and broaden their horizons. The school adopts a balanced linguistic approach that gives pupils a strong presence in Arabic, French, and English, without reducing any language to a single role.

items.title: Integrated Activities
items.detail: Sports, arts, cultural, and scientific activities are not peripheral — they are an integral part of our educational project. These activities develop aspects of personality that the textbook alone cannot: teamwork, discipline, creativity, and resilience in the face of challenges.

items.title: Future Skills
items.detail: We prepare our students for a world still taking shape. That's why we incorporate training in critical thinking, problem-solving, teamwork, and effective communication into our programs. We introduce them to technology and teach them to use it intelligently and responsibly.

balance.title: Balance: The Beating Heart of Our Project
balance.body: What distinguishes Madaris Nibras's project is the genuine balance between the different dimensions of human growth. We don't sacrifice values for academic performance, nor enjoyment for seriousness, nor identity for openness. We believe all these aspects reinforce one another when managed with awareness and harmony.

meta.title: Academic Levels — Madaris Nibras
meta.description: From preschool to high school — discover Madaris Nibras's academic levels in Tangier

levelsPage.heroSubtitle: A complete educational pathway from early childhood to high school
levelsPage.intro: Every academic level at Madaris Nibras is designed to meet the developmental needs of the student and prepare them for the next stage. We ensure pedagogical continuity and that every student feels supported and belonging throughout every stage of their growth.

items.title: Preschool
items.fullDescription: Preschool at Madaris Nibras is a warm, homelike environment. We welcome children in spaces specially designed to arouse their curiosity and develop their sense of security and belonging. Children learn through guided play, stories, songs, and sensorimotor activities. We introduce them early to all three languages in a natural and fun way. We allow them to develop their social and emotional skills, learn early independence, and integrate into collective life in a spirit of joy and participation.

items.title: Primary School
items.fullDescription: Primary school is the phase of building foundational skills. Students learn reading, writing, and arithmetic in Arabic, and develop their French and English skills in a methodical and progressive framework. We give special attention to Islamic education and Quran memorization, as well as arts and physical education. We integrate science and exploration activities through sensory methods that make students love knowledge and develop their intrinsic motivation for learning.
highlights: Solid foundations in Arabic and mathematics
French and English teaching from day one

items.title: Middle School
items.fullDescription: Middle school represents a phase of deepening and autonomy. Pupils face more specialized subjects with deeper content. We encourage critical thinking, questioning, and research. They continue a progressive English development pathway while strengthening skills across all three languages. They take part in collective projects and scientific and cultural activities that develop their personalities and broaden their horizons.

items.title: High School
items.fullDescription: High school is the phase of ambition and serious preparation for the future. Pupils prepare for national baccalaureate exams in various streams and continue developing their language skills through a progressive English development pathway. We give them individual attention and the psychological and academic support needed to navigate this stage with confidence. We encourage them to shape their future projects and connect learning to their ambitions.

meta.title: Languages and English Development — Madaris Nibras Tangier
meta.description: A modern Moroccan school in Tangier: a balanced linguistic approach in Arabic, French, and English, with a progressive pathway to strengthen English.

languagesPage.heroSubtitle: Multiple languages… a pupil better able to understand, express, and communicate
languagesPage.intro: At Madaris Nibras, we believe languages are not merely school subjects, nor separate categories, but tools to build the pupil's character, broaden their horizons, and strengthen their ability to understand, express, and communicate. The school therefore adopts a balanced linguistic approach that gives pupils a strong presence in Arabic, French, and English, without reducing any language to a single role; each language is a field for learning, communication, culture, openness, and confidence in expression.

arabic.title: Arabic
arabic.body: Arabic is presented at Madaris Nibras as a language of identity, communication, and expression that preserves roots and builds confidence in word and meaning. We accompany the pupil from the first letters in preschool to literary texts in high school, developing written and oral expression, strengthening their connection with Arabic through appropriate educational activities, and Quran memorisation within the school's educational project.

french.title: French
french.body: French holds an important place in the pupil's academic and relational pathway. We integrate it into curricula from the early years through modern communicative approaches that make it a living language for learning, expression, and interaction with their environment, and openness to varied fields of knowledge and culture.

english.title: English
english.body: Madaris Nibras gives special attention to English through a progressive pathway aimed at strengthening pupils' skills in comprehension, expression, communication, and practical use of the language. It is taught through interactive and audiovisual methods that help the pupil use the language confidently in class and beyond.

cambridge.title: Cambridge English
cambridge.body: Within this approach, pupils are gradually prepared for Cambridge English qualifications at levels suited to their stage of schooling. This pathway aims to prepare pupils at the end of lower secondary to reach A1 level, and pupils in the final baccalaureate year to reach B2 level, supporting their readiness for international academic pathways and future opportunities to apply to international universities. It remains part of strengthening English and preparing for qualifications, not a stand-alone international curriculum or an automatic guarantee of certification.

benefits.title: Benefits of Multilingual Education
items: Development of cognitive intelligence and intellectual flexibility
Access to global knowledge sources without barriers
Broader academic and professional opportunities at national and international levels
Progressive strengthening of English and appropriate preparation for Cambridge English qualifications
Strengthening cultural identity while opening up to others

meta.title: School Life — Madaris Nibras
meta.description: Discover school activities and events at Madaris Nibras Tangier

schoolLifePage.heroSubtitle: Activities are part of learning, not just an add-on
schoolLifePage.intro: We believe complete education goes beyond classrooms and textbooks. Activities help pupils discover their talents, develop character, confidence, communication, cooperation, and discipline. A rich school life makes the school a place pupils love.

items.title: Sports
items.description: Football, basketball, gymnastics, athletics, and more. We believe a healthy body carries a flourishing mind. Organized sports programs that build fair competition, teamwork, and discipline.

items.title: Swimming
items.description: Swimming instruction in a structured and safe program that introduces students to this vital sport from a young age. Swimming is a life skill, not just a sport.

items.title: Arts & Creativity
items.description: Drawing, calligraphy, handicrafts, theater, and drama. We provide spaces for free artistic expression that unleash students' creativity, develop their aesthetic taste, and build their self-confidence.

items.title: Culture & Events
items.description: Religious and national celebrations, science and literary competitions, educational trips, and cultural weeks. These events broaden students' horizons and nourish their connection to their identity.

items.title: Applied Sciences
items.description: Equipped laboratories and exploration activities that make science a living experience, not just theoretical information. Experimentation and inquiry ignite curiosity and anchor concepts deeply.

items.title: Technology & ICT
items.description: Equipped computer labs, introduction to basic programming, and safe and responsible use of the internet. We prepare our students to be conscious digital citizens.

items.title: Teamwork & Projects
items.description: Joint projects across classes and levels that teach communication, negotiation, and taking responsibility. The ability to work as part of a team is an essential skill in today's world.

community.title: A Living School Community
community.body: Madaris Nibras is not just buildings and curricula — it is a living educational community pulsating with authentic human relationships between students, teachers, administrators, and families. Throughout the year, we organize events that bring the school community together, strengthen bonds, and celebrate achievements.
